stories.title: Browns lose DE Wright for season, sign Barnett
stories.summary: The Browns placed starting defensive end Alex Wright on season-ending injured reserve with a ruptured Achilles and signed veteran defensive end Derek Barnett.

stories.title: 49ers' Kittle off PUP list, CMC returns to practice
stories.summary: The 49ers have activated tight end George Kittle from the PUP list as he chases a return for Week 1 against the Rams.

stories.title: Lamb's home burglarized while WR was at camp
stories.summary: CeeDee Lamb's home in Fairview, Texas, was burglarized while he was attending training camp with the Dallas Cowboys in Oxnard, California, according to police.

stories.title: New-look Haaland shut out as Man City wins late
stories.summary: Late goals from Marc Guéhi and Josko Gvardiol rescued Manchester City who eventually beat Bournemouth 2-1 in their Premier League opener.

stories.title: Chargers put center Biadasz on season-ending IR
stories.summary: The Chargers placed Tyler Biadasz on season-ending injured reserve after the center suffered damage to his ACL and additional injuries to his left knee.
